title: The coord hook's last-resort regex for announce.to_other_sessions crosses a closed coordination.announce object and reads a later announce key outside it
goal: the coord hook's fallback regex for announce.to_other_sessions does not read a key past the end of the coordination.announce object it found

run:
import importlib.util,tempfile,os,sys
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("ch",".claude/hooks/coord_hook.py");m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(m)
d=tempfile.mkdtemp()
open(os.path.join(d,"settings.json"),"w").write("{\"coordination\":{\"announce\":{}} \"x\":{\"announce\":{\"to_other_sessions\": false}}}")
sys.exit(0 if m.settings(d)[0]["to_other_sessions"] is True else 1)
